patch.description_long: Trump made the remarks during a June 29, 2025, interview with Fox News host Maria Bartiromo, after outlets reported on a preliminary Defense Intelligence Agency assessment of the U.S. strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities. Trump pleaded not guilty and denied wrongdoing. At arraignment, the court informed him of the charges and set the case’s next procedural steps. The case concerned whether business records were falsified to conceal other unlawful conduct, not whether making a private payment was itself a crime. The indictment stated prosecutors’ allegations; the charges were not proof of guilt, and Trump remained presumed innocent as the case proceeded.
